faqs.q: Where and how are the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits used?
faqs.a: The Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners stretch a stud hydraulically instead of turning the nut, for even preload on subsea flanges. The listing carries 14 part numbers, covering tensioners from 3/4 in to 2 in maximum thread and their seal kits.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits?
faqs.a: The listing carries 14 part numbers: tensioners such as EAJ1LC for 3/4 in to 7/8 in, EAJ2LC for 1 in to 1-1/8 in, EAJ4LC for 1-1/2 in to 1-5/8 in and EAJ5LC for 1-3/4 in to 2 in maximum thread, plus Aquajack seal kits, for example the AJ1 seal kit.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits?
faqs.a: Choose the tensioner by the stud diameter range printed in its item name, for example 1 in to 1-1/8 in for EAJ2LC, then order the matching quick-fastening nut and the seal kit. Match the tensioner to the stud diameter and thread.

faqs.q: What pressure rating do the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits have?
faqs.a: The listing does not give a pressure or load rating for the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits, because each tensioner and nut is matched to a stud diameter and thread. Give us the stud size, thread and the preload you need and we confirm the model and the pump pressure with the maker.

faqs.q: What are the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits made from?
faqs.a: The listing does not state materials for the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits. Tensioners and nuts are loaded to high stud preload, so ask us for the maker's data on the model and for subsea use ask about coating and seals.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO, ASME or EN standard for the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits and holds no certificates. If your project needs a conformity document or test certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue.

faqs.q: What do the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits connect to?
faqs.a: The Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits fit over the stud and pulls against the bolt end, so the stud thread, diameter and clearance must match. Match the tensioner to the stud diameter and thread, and the quick-fastening nut to the thread.

faqs.q: How do I fit and look after the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits?
faqs.a: Fit the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits square on the stud, stretch to the preload, run the nut down by hand and then release the pressure. Check the seals and the piston before each use, and tension in the sequence the joint procedure gives.

faqs.q: Where are the Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits used?
faqs.a: The Enerpac EAJ Aquajack subsea bolt tensioners and seal kits are used to tension flange and structural studs hydraulically instead of turning the nut, so the preload is even across a flange. Use it on pipelines, pressure vessels, wind turbines and subsea structures.
